title: Wang Xingxing from Unitree: Continuously Focus on Embodied Intelligence Technology and Explore New Products such as Humanoid Robots

content_html:
On August 7, Wang Xingxing, founder and CEO of Unitree Technology, stated in an online roadshow that listing on the capital market is a new starting point. The company will continue to focus on the core technology R&D and industrial applications of general-purpose embodied intelligent robots, promoting the earlier entry of intelligent robots into social service scenarios.

Wang Xingxing said that Unitree Technology will continue to advance key technology R&D, including embodied large models, scenario data collection and analysis, reinforcement learning, embodied body models, self-developed core components, and high-performance actuators, accelerating the synergy between software and hardware innovation.

In terms of product layout, Unitree Technology will explore more product forms and models, such as humanoid robots, quadruped robots, and mechs, to expand the application boundaries of embodied intelligent robots. The company hopes that robots can take over high-intensity and high-risk physical labor, improve production efficiency, and release human creativity.

As the embodied intelligence industry enters a stage of large-scale exploration, robot bodies, algorithm models, data systems, and core components have become key areas of competition. By clearly defining its technical roadmap and product expansion direction, Unitree Technology reflects the development trend of domestic robot companies moving from single product R&D to full-stack intelligent robot ecosystem construction.

content_html_zh:
8月7日，宇树科技创始人兼CEO王星星在网上路演中表示，资本市场上市是一个新的起点。 公司将继续专注于通用型实体智能机器人的核心技术研发和产业应用，推动智能机器人早日进入社会服务场景。

王星星表示，宇树科技将持续推进具身大模型、场景数据采集与分析、强化学习、具身人体模型、自主研发核心部件、高性能执行器等关键技术研发，加速软硬件创新协同。

在产品布局上，宇树科技将探索人形机器人、四足机器人、机甲机器人等更多产品形态和模式，拓展实体智能机器人的应用边界。 公司希望机器人能够接管高强度、高风险的体力劳动，提高生产效率，释放人类创造力。

随着体身智能产业进入规模化探索阶段，机器人本体、算法模型、数据系统、核心部件成为关键竞争领域。 宇树科技通过明确技术路线和产品拓展方向，体现了国内机器人企业从单一产品研发转向全栈智能机器人生态建设的发展趋势。
